I added `tags/utils.py` with `tag_slug(name)`, which returns `((tag := Tag(name)).save(), tag.slug)[1]` so it reads the slug from the tag rather than from `save()` and keeps working when the other engineer's change makes `Tag.save` return `None`; all 3 tests pass, and I haven't run `tag_slug` directly because the separate check needed an approval.
